item.description: ### Fixed - **Claude sessions in folders with an underscore, a space or other special characters now show their details.** Perch looked for such a session's transcript under the wrong name, so its row had no model, no context percentage, and a clock stuck at the time it started. Perch now names the folder the way Claude Code does, and finds very long paths by the session's own id. - **Claude's background helpers no longer appear as sessions.** `claude daemon`, `claude rc` and `claude self-hosted-runner` are tools, not conversations, and each used to show up as a row that did nothing.
